# World physics reference

<!-- Generated by tools/gen-weapon-docs.mjs from data/world/*.ron, data/weapons/*.ron, data/ships/*.ron and data/rulesets/*.ron. Do not edit by hand: change the
     data and run `node tools/gen-weapon-docs.mjs` (CI fails while this file is stale). -->

The numbers behind the world sliders and the asteroid belt: gravity wells (Gravity Chaos),
cave-ins (Instability), pigment on black-and-white levels (Palette 80 and above), and the
belt's radiation and drifting boulders. How they feel is in the
[player manual](../player-manual.md#the-level-fights-back); a server's rule set changes only
the pigment pickups and Belt Up's radiation scale.

## Gravity wells

The world generator places 1 + Gravity Chaos / 15 wells (at most 7, none at 0); each pulls
within its range (20 u, growing to 40 u at Gravity Chaos 100) with a strength of Gravity
Chaos / 100 of the strongest pull. Asteroid belts have a shepherd moon per sector from Gravity
Chaos 20.

| Rule | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Strongest pull of a level's well (Gravity Chaos 100) | 12 u/s² (40% of a Tinker's thrust) |
| Where the pull is strongest | 2.1 u from the core's centre; it fades to 0 at the well's range |
| Most pull on a ship, however many wells overlap | 40% of its thrust, so every ship can thrust out |
| Most pull on debris and missiles | 12 u/s² |
| A ship that does not thrust | drifts toward the well at its pull x 1 s (u/s) |
| Paperweight well | 6 s, 16 u range, up to 30% of a Tinker's thrust (9 u/s²) |
| The Architect's Gravity Chaos+ stroke | a well for the rule set's `well_secs` (see the [mode reference](modes.md#the-architect)) |

| Ship | Thrust (u/s² per axis) | Most pull from wells (u/s²) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Skitter | 30 | 12 |
| Tinker | 30 | 12 |
| Hauler | 24 | 9.6 |
| Tug | 30 | 12 |

**Bent by wells:** ships, debris, mines and Bolt Rocket, Eyeball, Flash Pod, Heavy Rocket, Paperweight, Prox Mine, Quicksilver, Seed Grenade, Seeker, Stalker Mine, Swarm Pod, Tectonic Charge.

**Fly straight:** Borrowed Time, Corkscrew, Echo Cannon, Fusion Charger, Leech Arc, Magnet Sneeze, Paint Thrower, Plasma Repeater, Polite Laser, Railspike, Ricochet Arc, Rivet Gun, Scatter Laser, Scrap Laser, Scrap Shotgun, Swap Harpoon.

## Instability and cave-ins

| Instability | 10 | 30 | 60 | 100 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Craters | 1.04x as wide | 1.12x as wide | 1.24x as wide | 1.4x as wide |
| Bolt Rocket craters in one spot that cave a tunnel in (ordinary rock, fired together) | 12 | 8 | 5 | 4 |

At Instability 0 craters keep their size and tunnels never cave in. Every crater strains the rock
of its 16 u region by its volume (weak rock 1.5x, ordinary 1x, hard
0.5x); the strain fades by 3% per second, so craters spread over time need more.

| Cave-in | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Warning (cracks, dust, rumble) | 1.5 s |
| Rubble | 5-9 spheres of weak rock, 1.5-3 u, from a hollow in the rock up to 24 u above |
| Debris | 4-8 pieces with 2-5 scrap each |
| Damage | 20 to ships within 3 u of the rubble (no kill credit) |
| How often | at most one cave-in per 8 s per level |
| Never | within 24 u of a spawn point, in the Heist core chamber, within 6 u of an extraction zone, or sealing a ship in (every ship near it keeps a way out 14 u long) |

## Pigment

Black-and-white levels (Palette 80 and above) and every Last Color Standing level have pigment
pickups at the pickup points.

| Rule | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Pigmented | 40 s (another pickup starts it again) |
| Damage bonus | +25% with every weapon |
| Splash when a pigmented ship dies | a pickup for 15 s |
| Last Color Standing | a pickup restores 17 colour instead (no damage bonus) |

| Rule set (id) | Pigment pickups | Respawn |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Belt Up** (`belt_up`) | 1 per 4 players, at least 2 | 30 s |
| **Duel** (`duel`) | 1 per 4 players, at least 2 | 30 s |
| **Heist** (`heist`) | 1 per 4 players, at least 2 | 30 s |
| **Hot Reactor** (`hot_reactor`) | 1 per 4 players, at least 2 | 30 s |
| **Last Color Standing** (`last_color_standing`) | 1 per 4 players, at least 2 | 45 s |
| **Paint the Void** (`paint_the_void`) | 1 per 4 players, at least 2 | 30 s |
| **Sandbox - all weapons** (`sandbox_all_weapons`) | 1 per 4 players, at least 2 | 30 s |
| **The Squeeze** (`squeeze`) | 1 per 4 players, at least 2 | 30 s |
| **Team Brawl** (`team_brawl`) | 1 per 4 players, at least 2 | 30 s |
| **The Architect** (`the_architect`) | 1 per 4 players, at least 2 | 30 s |

No pigment pickups: `instagib_brawl`.

## Radiation (asteroid belts)

Outside the belt radiation burns hull, past any Shield or gadget, and gives nobody the kill.
Belt Up scales it by its rule set's `radiation_scale` (built-in: 1x) while racing and turns it off during the start lights and heat results.

| Where | Hull per second | A full Tinker (100 hull) lasts |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 4 u or deeper inside the belt (or in the dust round the EXIT) | 0 | – |
| 2 u inside the belt | 0.4 | 250 s |
| at the belt's surface | 0.8 | 125 s |
| 2 u outside | 1.2 | 83 s |
| 4 u outside | 1.6 | 63 s |
| 6 u outside | 2.8 | 36 s |
| 8 u outside | 4 | 25 s |
| 13 u outside | 7 | 14 s |

The rate rises by 0.2 per u out to 4 u, then by 0.6 per u, up to 7 per second.

## Drifting boulders (asteroid belts)

Boulders (2-4 u) orbit through the belt at 2-4 u/s on fixed circles. They cannot be destroyed,
swallow shots (missiles go off on them without a crater) and push ships aside.

| Rule | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Damage | 8 on a contact faster than 8 u/s (no kill credit) |
| Bounce | a ship keeps 30% of its speed into the boulder, reversed |
